messages:
aisha_cs: Heads up: Kepler Health private/VPC preflight — quick sync? Network called out egress to KMS endpoint via NAT isn't whitelisted. See details below.
rafael_sre: Thanks — can you paste the failing logs or the sg rule they tried?
aisha_cs: They applied a security group with `0.0.0.0/0` outbound, but our KMS expects only their NAT IPs. Audit logs show DENY to kms.redwood.example.com:443 from 10.12.4.8
nina_ops: Adding the NAT IPs to allowlist should fix. Do we have a list? cc @sam_sales for customer confirmation.
sam_sales: I asked Kepler for the egress IPs — they sent 52.18.72.9 and 18.132.45.110. Confirmed.
rafael_sre: Ok plan: add those two to VPC egress ACL + update KMS key policy to include their AWS account id `123456789012` for decrypt/encrypt roles. Also enable audit-log forwarding to their SIEM.
aisha_cs: They also requested cross-account IAM role assumption. Quick checklist: 1) Create role in RedCloud with trust policy for Kepler account 2) Add condition on ExternalId 3) KMS kms:Encrypt permissions for that role.
nina_ops: Can someone run the preflight script? `./scripts/preflight-check.sh --customer kepler`
deploy-bot: preflight-check.sh started at 1765432500. Tests: network/connectivity,kms/iam,audit/logging
deploy-bot: network/connectivity: FAIL — outbound blocked to kms.redwood.example.com:443 from 10.12.4.8
rafael_sre: I'll open a temporary support window at 11:00 PT to jam with their network team. Assigning myself.
aisha_cs: :thumbsup: Thanks. Sam, ask them to whitelist those IPs and confirm NAT mapping. Also we should flag renewal risk slightly: if this isn't cleared within 5 business days, ops SLA concern.
sam_sales: Noted, I told Kepler we'll need this by EOD Wednesday. I'll follow up and post confirmation here.
nina_ops: Also capture feedback: they said docs around KMS cross-account were sparse. I'll add a short how-to to playbook.
aisha_cs: Perfect — capturing action items:
- rafael: network window 11:00 PT (in progress)
- sam: get NAT mapping + confirmation
- nina: add KMS cross-account doc snippet
- me: update account health score and alert renewals if delayed
Posting results here.
deploy-bot: preflight-check.sh completed at 1765432725. Summary: 1 FAIL, 2 WARN, 4 PASS.
